note: Hard B: the difference list of the first new-architecture recipe against its base. A lineage root has no upstream mother (base.json is null), so what this recipe IS, is what it writes on top of the framework stock cfg -- and this file is that statement, path by path. The gate refuses both directions: a changed path not listed here, and a listed path that no longer changes.

allowed.scene.robot: the shared frozen asset: usd, implicit-PD actuator groups, initial pose and soft limits
allowed.scene.terrain.terrain_type: flat ground is the question itself
allowed.scene.height_scanner: a scanner on flat ground scans a constant
allowed.observations.policy.height_scan: the scan observation goes with the scanner
allowed.observations.policy.enable_corruption: observation noise is a randomization, so it is off explicitly
allowed.actions.joint_pos: removed: leaving the single-group term would add 26 more action dims on the same joints
allowed.events.base_external_force_torque: no DR: interval wrench, and it is not c_k-gated in other lines
allowed.events.push_robot: no DR: interval velocity push, and it is not c_k-gated in other lines
allowed.events.reset_base.params.pose_range: reset_base must stay (it places the robot); its own randomization is zeroed axis by axis
allowed.events.reset_base.params.velocity_range: same event, velocity half, zeroed axis by axis
allowed.rewards.track_lin_vel_xy_miki: the tracking term: full 2D error, exp(-||v_cmd - v_yaw||^2 / sigma_sq)
allowed.rewards.belly_contact_force: continuous net base contact force, force_scale 706 N
allowed.rewards.ang_vel_xy_l2: removed: a constraint the first round does not need to attribute
allowed.terminations.base_contact.params.sensor_: base contact means down, so survival has a definition
allowed.curriculum.terrain_levels: no curriculum: the framework base's only curriculum term, removed
allowed.commands.base_velocity.heading_command: off, or the fixed command gets rewritten from the heading error
allowed.commands.base_velocity.rel_standing_envs: off, or that fraction of envs is commanded to zero while still collecting tracking reward
